trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Collect all 54 other trophies to claim the platinum. Finish the main campaign first, then circle back for collectibles, side activities, and any missable trophies in a second run. No extra requirements beyond earning everything else.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission 'Gone Fishing.' This tutorial mission introduces the dual-protagonist system and basic controls. Unlocks automatically as you start the game — no way to miss it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete all story missions in Chapter 1. This chapter establishes the Leonida setting and introduces key characters. Follow the primary mission markers on your map — it's impossible to miss if you progress the campaign.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all Chapter 2 missions. The narrative expands into Vice City proper with new criminal enterprises. Simply follow the main mission path — this unlocks naturally through story progression.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3's storyline missions. The conflict deepens with rival gangs and cartels. Continue following the primary mission markers to finish this chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the final chapter of the main story. This concludes the primary narrative arc before the finale. All story missions in this chapter must be completed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission of the game. This gold trophy marks the end of the main campaign. Simply play through to the conclusion of the narrative.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Breakfast Run' mission, an early story mission introducing key mechanics. This is a mandatory story mission that cannot be missed — progress naturally through the campaign.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish 'The Cartel Heist' mission, a major story heist. Follow the mission markers and complete the objectives. Unlocks automatically as part of the main campaign.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Child's Play' mission. This is a mandatory story mission that advances the plot. Simply follow the main quest line.

trophies.name: Heavy Is the Crown
trophies.guide: Finish 'King of the Hill' mission. A story-critical heist that cannot be skipped. Play through normally.

trophies.name: The Way Out
trophies.guide: Complete 'The Exit Strategy' mission. Another mandatory story beat. Just follow the main path.

trophies.name: Leonida's Most Wanted
trophies.guide: Earn a 5-star wanted level and survive long enough for it to register. Rampage through Vice City — shoot down helicopters, destroy vehicles, and cause mayhem until the military deploys. Find cover (parking garage, tunnel) and wait it out. Using a helicopter makes escape easier.

trophies.name: Full Throttle
trophies.guide: Win 10 street races across Leonida. Races appear as icons on the map after unlocking. Use a fast, well-handling car (sports or super class). Replay any race — only wins count. Track progress in the stats menu.

trophies.name: Sky High
trophies.guide: Finish 5 wingsuit challenges. These unlock after story progress. Jump from designated points, fly through rings, and land in the target zone. Use small adjustments — overcorrecting causes crashes. Bronze medal on each is sufficient.

trophies.name: Hook, Line, Sinker
trophies.guide: Catch 20 fish total. Fishing spots are marked on the map near water. Equip a rod, cast, wait for a bite, then reel in using the prompt. Different locations yield different species. This accumulates naturally — fish whenever you pass a spot.

trophies.name: The Big One
trophies.guide: Land a legendary fish. These rare catches appear at specific legendary fishing spots (marked with a crown icon). Use the best bait and rod available. Patience is key — legendary bites are infrequent. Save before attempting if worried about losing the catch.

trophies.name: Treasure Hunter
trophies.guide: Locate all 50 hidden packages scattered across Leonida. These glow faintly and emit a subtle sound when nearby. Check rooftops, alleyways, docks, swamp islands, and underwater. A helicopter makes scanning large areas faster. The in-game tracker shows your count. No package is missable — all remain accessible after story.

trophies.name: Signal Seeker
trophies.guide: Find all 30 radio signal collectibles. These appear as distinct antenna icons on the map once you're close. Each plays a unique audio log when collected. Use a vehicle with good off-road capability for remote locations. None are missable.

trophies.name: Art Lover
trophies.guide: Photograph all 25 street art murals. Pull out the in-game phone camera, frame the artwork, and snap a photo. The game confirms each new discovery. Murals are concentrated in urban Vice City and surrounding neighborhoods. None are missable.

trophies.name: Wildlife Photographer
trophies.guide: Take photos of 15 different animal species using the phone camera. Animals spawn in appropriate biomes: alligators in swamps, deer in forests, birds near water, sharks offshore. Get close enough for the game to register the species. No rush — all remain available post-story.

trophies.name: Clean Sweep
trophies.guide: Finish every side mission in the game. These appear as distinct icons on the map (not the main story markers). Some unlock only after certain story chapters. Check the pause menu's mission log to track which remain. Nothing is permanently missable — all side content stays available after the finale.

trophies.name: Empire Builder
trophies.guide: Fully upgrade every purchasable business. Businesses unlock mid-story and generate passive income. Invest profits into upgrades (security, production, distribution) until each hits max level. Requires significant capital — grind heists or laundering if short. Track progress in the empire menu.

trophies.name: Weapon Master
trophies.guide: Max out 10 different weapons at a gun bench. Each weapon has multiple upgrade tiers (damage, accuracy, magazine, etc.). Collect weapon parts from crates, enemies, and vendors. Prioritize weapons you use often. The bench shows which are fully upgraded.

trophies.name: Wheels of Fortune
trophies.guide: Acquire 30 distinct vehicle models in your garage. Steal off the street, buy from dealerships, or earn as mission rewards. Only unique models count — duplicates don't help. Check the vehicle collection screen to see gaps. Includes cars, bikes, boats, and aircraft.

trophies.name: Speed Demon
trophies.guide: Hit the maximum speed of 5 different supercars. Find a long straight highway (the Overseas Highway works well), floor it, and hold top speed for a few seconds. The speedometer must peak at the vehicle's listed max. Supercars spawn in wealthy districts or can be bought.

trophies.name: Air Superiority
trophies.guide: Execute 50 aerial stunts with aircraft. Take a plane or helicopter, gain altitude, then perform barrel rolls, loops, inverted flight, or low-altitude passes near landmarks. Stunt counter appears on screen. Best done with a nimble stunt plane. Accumulates naturally if you fly often.

trophies.name: Deep Diver
trophies.guide: Stay submerged for 30 cumulative minutes. Use scuba gear (unlocked mid-game) or a submersible. Swim along the reef or just idle underwater — time counts either way. Check stats to track progress. No single session required.

trophies.name: Night Owl
trophies.guide: Finish 10 activities (missions, races, collectibles, etc.) during in-game hours 00:00–05:00. Wait at a safehouse or use the 'skip time' feature if available. Activities completed during this window count automatically.

trophies.name: Social Butterfly
trophies.guide: Complete a hangout activity with every available contact. Contacts unlock through story and side missions. Open the phone, select a contact, and choose 'Hang Out.' Each offers unique activities (drinks, golf, strip club, etc.). Track in the social menu.

trophies.name: High Roller
trophies.guide: Net $50,000 in winnings at the casino. Play high-stakes blackjack, poker, or roulette. Buy in with maximum chips, play conservatively, and cash out when ahead. Can grind lower stakes if preferred — only net profit counts. Save before big sessions.

trophies.name: Getaway Driver
trophies.guide: Successfully escape 20 police pursuits triggered by missions or free-roam crimes. Lose the wanted radius by breaking line of sight, using tunnels, switching vehicles, or hiding. Each successful escape increments the counter. Happens naturally during normal play.

trophies.name: Sharp Shooter
trophies.guide: Land 100 headshot kills on enemies. Use precision weapons (sniper rifles, marksman rifles, pistols with scopes). Aim for the head — the game registers cleanly. Free-aim mode makes this easier. Grind in combat-heavy side missions if needed.

trophies.name: Explosive Personality
trophies.guide: Trigger 500 explosions total. Grenades, RPGs, sticky bombs, vehicle explosions, gas tanks, and environmental hazards all count. Fast method: throw grenades at clustered vehicles in traffic. Counter tracks in stats. Very achievable in a normal playthrough.

trophies.name: Property Tycoon
trophies.guide: Purchase 10 distinct properties (safehouses, businesses, garages). Properties unlock as you progress and earn money. Open the dynasty/property menu, browse listings, and buy. Some require specific story milestones. Track owned count in the portfolio screen.

trophies.name: Fashion Icon
trophies.guide: Purchase 50 individual clothing pieces from any store. Includes shirts, pants, shoes, hats, accessories, masks, and outfits. Visit clothing shops (marked on map) and buy whatever's affordable. Changes in each shop's rotation. Cumulative across all characters.

trophies.name: Stock Picker
trophies.guide: Earn $100,000 net profit from stock trading. The market (BAWSAQ/LCN) reacts to story events and player actions. Invest heavily before assassination missions or major story beats, sell after the spike. Track portfolio value in the phone's finance app. Patience pays.

trophies.name: Master Thief
trophies.guide: Successfully burgle 15 homes or businesses. Burglaries unlock mid-game. Enter at night, avoid occupants/cameras, grab valuables, and escape. Each completed heist counts. Minimap shows targets. No fail state — getting caught just ends that attempt.

trophies.name: Trafficker
trophies.guide: Finish 20 drug trafficking runs. These side missions unlock after meeting certain contacts. Pick up product, deliver to drop points, avoid police. Each run takes a few minutes. Repeatable — just keep accepting jobs from the contact.

trophies.name: Street Cred
trophies.description: Reach max reputation with all gangs.
trophies.guide: Max out reputation with every gang faction. Rep increases by completing missions for them, wearing their colors, and operating in their territory. Some gangs are rivals — balance carefully. Check the reputation screen for progress. Late-game unlocks make this faster.

trophies.name: No Witnesses
trophies.guide: Finish any major heist without triggering an alarm. Requires stealth approach: suppressors, melee takedowns, hacking cameras, avoiding sightlines. The game signals if you're detected. Save before the heist, reload if spotted. The Cartel Heist or a replayable heist works.

trophies.name: Clean Escape
trophies.guide: Evade a 5-star wanted level and survive. At 5 stars, military vehicles and helicopters pursue aggressively. Best strategy: grab a fast helicopter or plane, fly low over water or through city canyons to break lock-on, then hide in a tunnel or parking garage until the search radius passes.

trophies.name: Pacifist Run
trophies.guide: Finish any mission (story or side) without killing anyone. Use stealth, melee knockouts, distractions, and environmental hazards. Mission must allow non-lethal completion — some forced combat sections prevent this. Check mission briefings for stealth options. Replay on a separate save if needed.

trophies.name: Perfectionist
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal on 10 missions. Gold requires meeting all optional objectives (time, accuracy, damage taken, stealth, etc.) shown during the mission. Replay missions from the menu to improve. Focus on shorter missions with clear objectives. Track progress in mission replay screen.

trophies.name: Dual Protagonist
trophies.guide: Switch between the two protagonists 50 times. Hold the character switch button (touchpad/d-pad) and select the other character. Do this during free-roam — each press counts. Quick way: spam switch while standing still. Accumulates naturally if you alternate playstyles.

trophies.name: Leonida Legend
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the stats menu. This covers story missions, side missions, collectibles, activities, challenges, and more. The stats screen breaks down each category. Use it as your master checklist — when everything reads 100%, this unlocks.

trophies.name: Partners in Crime
trophies.guide: Trigger a special co-op story moment between the two protagonists. This happens at a specific narrative beat during the campaign. Progress the main story — it unlocks automatically at a key scene. Cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 tracked choices across playthroughs. Dialogue options, mission approach decisions, and branching paths all count. This accumulates naturally — a thorough single playthrough or two will hit the target. No need to grind specific choices.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail a mission or objective, then retry and succeed. Simply replay any failed mission to completion. This happens naturally during normal play — no need to intentionally fail.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: HIDDEN — Trigger a rare world event. Witness a strange or unexplained encounter: unusual lights in the Everglades at night, cryptid sightings, or glitch-like phenomena. These spawn randomly. Best odds: explore remote swamps and forests after 22:00 in-game time. Use a helicopter to cover ground fast. No fixed location — persistence is key.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down a pedestrian with a melee attack while leaning out a moving vehicle window. Drive slowly in a convertible or windowed car, line up a pedestrian, lean out (hold aim), and press melee. Timing matters — practice in a quiet area.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills via your criminal contacts. Marked Bills drop from heists, bank robberies, and major scores. Visit laundering contacts (unlocked mid-game) regularly to process the cash. This accumulates over the course of a playthrough.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 at shops and services. Buy weapons, ammo, vehicles, clothing, properties, upgrades, and consumables. This happens naturally — just purchase what you need. Check the stats menu to track total spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties available for purchase. Garages unlock as you progress through the story and earn money. Open the property menu, check each garage listing, and buy them as they become affordable. Some require story progress to appear.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 unique vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app unlocks mid-story. Open it, select 'Register Vehicle,' and choose from owned or stolen vehicles. Each distinct model counts once. Steal variety — cars, bikes, boats all work.
